plan.notes: Source: official SUNY Corning Community College 2026-2027 Academic Catalog (corning.cleancatalog.net, the college's official online catalog), degree page 'Computer Science, Associate in Science' (Transfer, Division of STEM). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the catalog's 'Course Sequencing' sample sequence plus the 'Program Requirements' table, which publishes Total Credits 64. Credit math: sequence term totals 17/15/15/17 = 64, matching the published degree total exactly (no discrepancy). TRUE credential per the catalog: Associate in Science (Transfer) in Computer Science. Prereqs verified on the current 2026-2027 catalog course pages: CSCS 1320 requires CSCS 1240 (modeled); CSCS 1730 requires 'be taking or have taken CSCS 1240', i.e. concurrent enrollment is permitted (modeled as CSCS 1240); CSCS 2320 requires CSCS 1320 (modeled); CSCS 2330 requires 'MATH 1240 and either CSCS 1320 or CSCS 2420' - CSCS 2420 and MATH 1240 are real catalog course codes but neither appears in the published sequence, so both are listed in external_prereqs and the either/or plus the MATH 1240 requirement are documented here rather than modeled; CSCS 2650 requires 'CSCS 1320 or CSCS 2420' (either/or documented here, modeled with both codes); MATH 1610 requires 'MATH 1411-1412 or MATH 1413' - MATH 1413 is the in-plan path shown in the sequence (the MATH 1411-1412 alternative documented here); ENGL 1020's catalog prerequisite is ENGL 1010, and the catalog's ENGL 1110 course page states ENGL 1110 'may take this course in place of ENGL 1010' for CSCI-AS students, so ENGL 1020 is modeled with prereq ENGL 1110 (the in-plan substitute); ENGL 1110 requires placement or ENGL 0980; MATH 1413 requires MATH 1225 or MATH 1240 or placement; CSCS 1200 and CSCS 1240 require eligibility for college-level composition plus completion of all developmental mathematics - all placement/assessment details documented here, not modeled as course prereqs. Choice slots: two 3-credit Computer Science Elective slots (catalog footnote 2: 'Select from CSCS, CSIT, CSNT, CSNS, or CSWT. Select to fulfill requirements of transfer college.'; catalog footnote 7: 'Program Elective: CSNT 1200 recommended.'), one Humanities Elective, two Laboratory Science Electives (catalog footnote 1: 'If using PHYS for laboratory science elective, select PHYS 1010 or higher'), one Liberal Arts and Sciences Elective (catalog footnote 5: chosen from The Arts, US History & Civic Engagement, World History & Global Awareness, or World Languages), one DEI/SJ course, one Social Sciences Elective, and one 1-credit Wellness (Activity or Awareness) slot. Catalog caveats: the sequence is 'intended as a guide for academic planning. It need not be followed exactly or completed in four semesters.' Footnote: based on placement, students might be required to take developmental and/or prerequisite classes before the required English and Math courses. High school or equivalent preparation required: biology, chemistry or physics and four years of mathematics (algebra, geometry or intermediate algebra, trigonometry, precalculus) - students lacking it may take longer to complete the program. Catalog 'Shelf Life Alert': computer courses may not be used for any computer program if more than 5 years have passed since the course was taken. Degree is also offered via distance education (50%+ online). 20 slots total across 4 semesters.
